# dsh-image-zoom
**A real image viewer for DeepSeek Harness.** Click any content image in chat — a Markdown image, a
tool screenshot, a workspace artifact — and get wheel/pinch zoom, two-finger and drag panning, galle
ry browsing, and downloads that arrive with a sensible filename.
English | 中文
## Why this plugin
The built-in image preview is a step up from a raw ``, but it is not a viewer: you cannot reall
y zoom, pan on both axes, or keep a good filename when you save. `dsh-image-zoom` takes over content
-image clicks and draws its own dialog:
| You want to… | How it works |
| Zoom with a mouse | Wheel zooms at the pointer. A normal notch (Windows 100 / Chrome 120) zooms im
mediately; a smooth-scroll or precise mouse with tiny deltas is confirmed as an isolated event after

75 ms and zooms too. |
| Zoom with a trackpad | Pinch (`ctrl`+wheel) zooms continuously. |
| Pan le
ft/right and up/down | A two-finger scroll stream pans both axes; drag also pans; `Shift`+wheel pans

sideways. |
| Read something small | Fit / 1:1 / double-click, `+`/`-`, typed percentage, 5%–4000%,

rotate 90°. |
| Flip through screenshots | `←`/`→` or the side chevrons; `3 / 7` in the footer. |
|
Keep the file | Download with a generated name, copy the image, copy an external image link, or ope
n a workspace original in the system default app. |

## Requirements
| Item | Value |
| DSH | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` (declared in `engines.dsh`); developed and tested on DSH Desktop `0.

2.1-rc.5` |

| Platform | macO
S tested on the desktop app; Windows uses the same web client (the wheel notch path is covered by te
sts via synthetic 100/120 deltas). |
## Gestures and shortcuts
| Input | Action |

| Mouse wheel (one notch) | Zoom at the pointer |
| Pinch / `Ctrl`+wheel / `⌘`+wheel / `Alt`+wheel |

Zoom |
| Two-finger scroll stream | Pan both axes |
| `Shift`+wheel | Pan sideways |
| Drag | Pan |

| `+` / `-` | Zoom 25% |
| `0` / `1` | Fit / actual size |
| Double-click | Fit ↔ 1:1 |
| `←` / `→`

| Previous / next image |
| `Shift`+arrow keys | Pan 72 px |
| `R` / `Shift`+`R` | Rotate 90° clock

wise / counter-clockwise |
| `Esc` | Close (first exits the zoom input) |
The footer has three explicit wheel modes — **Auto / Zoom / Pan** — stored in `localStorage`. Auto i
s explained above; choose *Zoom* if your mouse's smooth-scroll driver breaks the auto heuristic, or
*Pan* if you want scroll to always move the picture.
### Download naming
Every download is saved as:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **description** = the image `alt` text, else a meaningful source filename, else the localized “ima

ge”.
- The local timestamp keeps names unique and sortable; the extension follows the detected forma

t, so blob-backed screenshots never land as `.bin`.
- Characters Windows forbids are replaced, reser
ved device names get a trailing `_`, and long descriptions are capped at 48 characters.
The download button's tooltip previews the exact name; the macOS save dialog opens with it already f
oad button's tooltip previews the exact name; the macOS save dialog opens with it already filled in.
### Header actions
| Button | What it does |

| ↓ Download | Save the original with the name above |
| ⧉ Copy image | Copy to the clipboard as PNG

/JPEG |
| 🔗 Copy link | Only for off-origin `http(s)` images: copy the absolute URL |
| ↗ Open origi
nal | Workspace images (served via `/api/file?path=…`) open in the **system default app** through th
e Host's `openWorkspacePath`; external images open in a new window; `blob:`/`data:` attachments expl

ain that they have no local path |
| ✕ Close | Same as `Esc` |
## Feedback and support
- **Bugs and feature requests:** GitHub Issues — the primary channel; please use the templates and i

nclude DSH version, OS, and reproduction steps.
- **X / Twitter:** @robinham — short questions and r

elease notes.
- **Questions and usage help:** GitHub Discussions when enabled; otherwise open an iss

ue.
- **Security reports:** do not open a public issue. See SECURITY.md.
- **Response expectation:**
this is a personally maintained project; issues are answered on a best-effort basis, usually within
a personally maintained project; issues are answered on a best-effort basis, usually within a week.
See SUPPORT.md for the full support policy and docs/identity-and-release.md for the versioning and r
for the full support policy and docs/identity-and-release.md for the versioning and release policy.
## Versioning
- Semantic Versioning: patch for fixes, minor for backward-compatible features, major for breaking c

hanges.
- Every release updates CHANGELOG.md and states its DSH compatibility in `engines.dsh`.
- A
DSH release that drops compatibility is treated as a breaking change for this plugin.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin is a single client entry (`client.js`) with no build step. Tests drive a minimal DSH-like
harness over HTTP with wheel, pointer, keyboard, double-click and download behavior. See tests/READ
ME.md for the isolation rules.
